goal:
A reviewer asked me to double-check a value from Varga et al. (2023), "Bounds on Wind-Farm Wakes" (http://proceedings-in-quiet-computing.example/articles/b8cbd9-bounds-on-wind-farm-wakes).
What median latency does Table 2 report for station S-12? Please give the value with its unit and tell me which source you used.

paragraphs: We study wind-farm wakes across five monitoring stations using a Bayesian model.
Authors: Mateo Varga, Vera Fairbairn. Published in Proceedings in Quiet Computing, 2023.
Table 2 reports the median latency for each station.

sections: Abstract

We report median latency measurements from five monitoring stations collected between 2021 and 2023. A pilot survey in 2018 had put the regional median latency at 483.2 ms; we find marked differences between upland and coastal sites.
1. Introduction
Earlier studies of wind-farm wakes relied on single-site records [1, 2]. A multi-site campaign makes it possible to separate local effects from regional trends [3].
2. Methods

Station metadata are listed in Table 1. Measurements follow the protocol of [3]. Values from the 2020 campaign are given in Table 3 for comparison and are not directly comparable with the 2023 campaign because the instruments changed.
3. Results
Table 2 reports the median latency for each station in the 2023 campaign. The largest change relative to 2020 was observed at station B-04.
4. Discussion
The spread between stations exceeds the measurement uncertainty, which suggests that site conditions dominate. Longer records are needed to confirm the trend.
References
[1] Okafor et al. (2017). [2] Kowalczyk and Abernathy (2019). [3] Aaltonen et al. (2020).
